functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI event registration; no game state)
functions.notes: Handler names of interest to server protocol: onPetFightClick, onPetProduceClick (pet produce/gathering), NotifyPetAvatarEvent.

Sets shop-mode flag DAT_123bbab1 = (param_5 == 2). Pushes CurrentBindMoney/CurrentUnbindMoney (from two FUN_1025b060 money getters) and strPetShopTitle to the Scaleform model when the player entity (DAT_1202e818+0xd0 -> +0x90) is valid.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (display of server-owned money; money values read locally via FUN_1025b060)
formulas: shopModeFlag DAT_123bbab1 = (param_5 == 2)
param_4[1] presence-flags: bit6 ((>>6)&1) gates optional string/object refs (recurring TDR-style presence pattern across chunk)

functions.purpose: Handles _requestNpcSales (only when param_5==7). Builds shopSaleItemDataArray of SALE_ITEM_DATA entries (each with nested EXCHANGE_DATA_CLASS / arrayExchangeItem) for the pet-shop NPC sale list, with pagination. Iterates the shop's sale-record container, filters by category/shopID/etc, and for each visible page item emits a VO: backItem, SaleItemId(*rec), shopID(rec[1]), ItemId(rec[8]), ItemNum(rec[9]), UnBindGold(byte rec[0xb]), salesCount, backItemIndex, itemPrice, itemName, maxStackCount(itemInfo+0x50), packTag, currentBindMoney, currentMoney, plus per-exchange itemName/itemCount/itemID/currentCounts and up to 13 special-item slots.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO builder for display; prices/counts derived from client-side item info + server-synced sale records. Server remains authoritative for actual buy/sell transactions.
formulas: page skip count local_fc = (local_58 >= 0 && local_8c > 0) ? local_58 * local_8c : 0  (local_58=page index/size input arg7@rec[0x14], local_8c=count arg from rec[0xe])
salesCount local_b4 = (local_d8 - firstRec) / 0xb0  (0xb0 = size of one sale-record struct)
itemPrice = FUN_114b74e0(rec-2, rec[9])  (unit price * ItemNum); when itemInfo(FUN_10254130(rec[8]))==0 -> itemPrice=0, itemName=empty, maxStackCount=0
exchange itemCount = rec[9] * exchangePrice, where exchangePrice local_5c = FUN_114b7110(rec-2,*ex)+ex[1]; iterate ex pairs from rec[0x1f]..rec[0x20] (stride 2)
currentCounts = FUN_113f9300(0,itemID,0) + FUN_113f9300(2,itemID,0) + FUN_113f9300(10,itemID,0)  (owned counts across bag containers 0,2,10)
packTag local_54: 0 if page position local_88==0 (first); 2 if local_88==local_8c-1 or last record (rec+0x2a==end); else 1 (middle)

record stride = 0x2c dwords (0xb0 bytes): loop advances local_50 += 0x2c; ItemId at rec[8], ItemNum at rec[9], UnBindGold byte at rec[0xb], SaleItemId at rec[0], shopID at rec[1], exchange list rec[0x1f]..rec[0x20]

special items: loop iVar3 0..12 (13 types); FUN_108cfae0 gets (count,name), FUN_108cfc80 gets currentSpecial count; fields specialItemName%d/specialItemCounts%d/currentSpecialItem%dCounts/specialItemType%d
costs: UnBindGold flag per item (rec[0xb] low byte)
13 special-item exchange slots per sale item
functions.notes: gated by param_5==7 and valid player logic component (DAT_1202e818+0xd0+0x90+0xb4()). local_100 = *(playerLogic+0x2cd8) is the pet/shop sub-component. Sale-record struct size 0xb0 is load-bearing. Verify FUN_114b74e0 (price) and FUN_113f9300 (bag count by container id) against economy chunk.

functions.purpose: Config-record accessor for CCatCuisineInfo (Felyne/Palico cuisine buff table). Resolves the singleton manager (CCatCuisineInfo::GetManager, fallback CInfoManager::FindByName). Then does the standard CInfoManager 2D paged-array lookup to return the record pointer for key param_1.
functions.serverRelevance: config-data lookup (cuisine buff definitions); data table shared by client and server, server authoritative for applying cuisine buffs.
formulas: lookup: if param_1==-1 return 0; if (param_1==0 && mgr[0xc]!=0) return 0; require mgr[10]!=0; idx = param_1 - mgr[0xc] (base id at [0xc]); require 0<=idx<mgr[9] (count at [9]); row=*(mgr[8] + (idx / mgr[10])*4) (table ptr [8], stride/page mgr[10]); if row!=0 return *(row + (idx % mgr[10])*4)
This paged-array pattern (base [0xc], count [9], stride [10], table [8]) is reused by all CInfoManager accessors in this chunk.
functions.notes: Related TLV: TlvCatCuisineData / TlvCatCuisineState. Cuisine buff numeric values live in the record this returns; not dereferenced here.

functions.purpose: Builds the farm/gather pet VO for UI. Requires valid player logic component and a gather flag (vtbl+0x16c). Pushes: farmPoint(*(ctx+0x14)), farmExp(FUN_1025b060), bFriendGatherBonus(byte ctx+0xe8), bSkipCutScene(byte ctx+0xe9), bFarmPetVisible(cvar g_ShowFarmPet), ownerID. If owner != local player's 64-bit ID (DAT_123bbac8/DAT_123bbacc), resolves the friend entry and adds friendName, friendFarmPoint(*(friend+0x4c)), friendRemainGatherCnt(*(+0xe4)). Sets param_1 status byte (2,then result 0/1).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO builder; farmPoint/farmExp/remainGatherCnt are server-owned values displayed here. Server authoritative for gather counts and rewards.
formulas: friend check: (**(piVar2+0xc0))() (owner 64-bit id) compared to CONCAT44(DAT_123bbacc,DAT_123bbac8) (local player id); equal => own pet path (status=1)
ctx offsets: farmPoint @ +0x14, bFriendGatherBonus @ +0xe8 (byte), bSkipCutScene @ +0xe9 (byte), friendRemainGatherCnt @ +0xe4
friend entry offsets: friendFarmPoint @ +0x4c, name id @ +0x24
costs: farmPoint, farmExp, friendFarmPoint, friendRemainGatherCnt (gather currency/counters, server-owned)
functions.notes: g_ShowFarmPet is a client cvar via DAT_1202e818+0x2c (console). friendRemainGatherCnt read from unaff_EDI+0xe4 (decompiler lost the base; = ctx).

functions.purpose: Builds two VOs. (1) PetPropertyALLVO_CLASS_NAME.petList: iterates the player's pet array (stride 0x30) building per-pet entries strName, level, petindex, petid, status, otherStatus. (2) PetFLSuccessVo (farm-advance / breeding success): iterates advancement levels and, via CFarmAdvPetInfo record lookup (paged-array), fills strSuccess, strBigSuccess into successList, plus needToolCount/needToolID/needToolName/needToolIcon.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO builder; pet list & advancement (soul-beast/breeding 'success' rate) data are server-owned and displayed here. CFarmAdvPetInfo supplies success text/tool requirements.
formulas: pet-list iteration count = (iStack_f4 - firstPet) / 0x30 (pet entry stride 0x30 bytes); per entry: status @ +0x00 area, transform block copied from +0x20..+0x2c
CFarmAdvPetInfo lookup (paged array on puVar7): base +0x30, count +0x24, stride +0x28, table +0x20 -> record used for strSuccess/strBigSuccess
advancement loop index uVar4 from 1, count = (unaff_EDI - successListBase)/0x30
costs: needToolCount / needToolID (materials required for pet advancement/breeding success)
functions.notes: PetFLSuccessVo = 'FL' (farm/breed?) success VO. 'strSuccess'/'strBigSuccess' = normal vs great success outcome strings. Actual success probabilities not computed here (server authoritative); this only reads config text. Verify CFarmAdvPetInfo record fields for numeric success rates in a later chunk.

This is a flat vector<ptr> lookup, distinct from the paged-array pattern used by CCatCuisine*/CPetAvatarInfo.

functions.purpose: Initializes/positions the pet SOUL (soul-beast) render object and plays 'pet_soul_idle'. Requires this+0x14 (entity) valid. quaternion rotate: rotates local offset (this+0x1c..+0x1e) by quat (this+0x15..+0x18) to produce world pos added to base pos (this+0x19..+0x1b)
functions.notes: 'pet_soul_idle' is the soul-beast idle animation clip. Rendering only; evolution/state is server-owned.

functions.purpose: Builds the pet (Palico) animation/action state machine: registers the full set of pet action states and their signal->locomotion transition rules. Sets default state NORMAL_RUN (0x17), a blend param +0x2d4=0.5f. Enumerated actions include: eat drug/meat/dragon meat/chocolate/coke meat, flute type 1 & 2, set-on-ground, set large/small bucket, throw, smash, sharpen weapon, collect plant, strip, mine, go-to-cuisine, catch, cliff-jump/parapet fall/fall, fish begin, vehicle/speedboat, net fishing, climb ladder, low/med climb, find egg, bake start, carry egg idle; plus tired/creep/back-to-boss locomotion variants.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (animation graph). Enumerates the pet's supported actions/attack-modes for cross-reference, but does not compute stats.
formulas: initial action state id = 0x17 (NORMAL_RUN)
flag bits: (param_1+0x80) |= 0x11; (param_1+0x2d4) = 0x3f000000 = 0.5f (blend/transition weight)
FUN_10f5bd40(6, handler) registers priority-6 transitions; FUN_10f5a480(a,b,list) wires tired/locomotion sub-states
functions.notes: Best client-side inventory of pet actions. Action-state names (NORMAL_TAKE_MEAT, FLUTE_TYPE_1/2, NORMAL_MINE, NORMAL_COLLECT, BAKE_START, NET_FISHING, etc.) map to gather/combat/support behaviors the server drives. 28 trailing FUN_10f61a80() are per-state cleanup/finalize calls.
